heuristics.statement: Conditioned on a collision at one claw of a window, another claw's key hit on the same chaining value cv follows the rounds 18..19 trail (and hence collides) with probability at most EPS_KEY = 2^-7.
heuristics.scope: Cross-claw pair term D_cross = (896 * 3,198,000 * 2^-7) / 2^33 = 2.606073e-3 inside the window second-order Bonferroni divisor DIV.
heuristics.extrapolation: 28-seed paired ALL-48 panel tested 1,246 colliding cv clusters (64 virtual other-claw trials per hit -> 79,744 clustered trials per arm, real hit cv vs uniform random cv): xa18=40,152 vs xu18=40,046 (ratio 1.00265) and xa20=0, xu20=0. Because blocks of 64 trials share a single hit cv, we do not claim an i.i.d. n=79,744 Clopper-Pearson bound; EPS_KEY=2^-7 is a declared heuristic ceiling supported by exact parity with the random-cv row-19 survival baseline (~2^-18..2^-22, leaving >8 bits of heuristic headroom even after a 32-mate union bound).
